title: chore(shared): name the batch window in seconds and add an item cap
body: Renames `BATCH_WINDOW` to `BATCH_WINDOW_SECONDS` so the unit is in the name, and adds `MAX_BATCH_ITEMS` for the upcoming size-based flush. `metrics.py` is migrated to the new names; the docstrings on `enqueue` and `drain` are unrelated readability tweaks.
